issues.message: Mobus §4.3: flow edges require k ≠ o; 'recycle' has the same endpoint as source and sink, and self-dependency is not representable in the 8-tuple
issues.suggestion: Remove the self-loop; feedback as a first-class cycle is Cybernetic mode (not yet available)

issues.message: interface 'Tank' carries no boundary-crossing flow — Mobus defines an interface as a component that transports a flow across the boundary, so one that transports nothing is a mislabelled component (Lean `MobusSystem.interfaces_carry_flow`)
issues.suggestion: Draw the flow this interface gates between it and an environmental entity, or drop the interface designation

issues.message: flow 'supply' enters the system but crosses the boundary without an interface — in Mobus's tuple every external flow passes through a member of I (SSF `bipartite_implies_boundary_complete`: G is bipartite between environment objects and interfaces), so a crossing flow with no interface is a hole in the membrane the author never declared
issues.suggestion: Designate the component this flow attaches to as an interface (SL: add `interface` to its component line), or re-route the flow through an existing one
